name: bizgenius
description: Ask your AI about the papers citing your products, read your ChatGenius log, analyze research fields, see how visitors use your BizGenius tools, and find academic leads.

interface.longDescription:
BizGenius connects your AI assistant to your own BizGenius account, so you can ask about your data in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards. The tools available depend on the products your account has.

What you can do:
• Citations — search and summarize the published papers that cite your products, see the exact sentence where a product is mentioned, get counts and trends, and find your top citing organizations.
• Citation widget analytics — see how visitors to your website use your citation widget: visitors, paper clicks and searches.
• ChatGenius analytics — review the questions and conversations your website visitors had with your ChatGenius assistant, with trends and breakdowns.
• Deep Analysis — get the bibliometric landscape of a research field: publication trend and growth, leading journals, authors, institutions, countries, key topics and top papers.
• Academic leads — preview researchers to contact about a product (name, email, affiliation, and the paper or grant they were found on), and export the full list.
• Export — have a spreadsheet or bibliography emailed to you for anything too large to read in chat.

Everything is read-only except exports, which are emailed to the account holder. BizGenius only ever shows your own account's data, and never receives your conversations. Sign-in is through BizGenius with OAuth — no password or API key is shared with the assistant.

New to BizGenius? Learn more at https://www.biz-genius.com.

positive.description: Count product citations in a year
positive.prompt: How many papers cited our products in 2025, and which journals published them?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of citing papers for 2025 and the journals, from the account's own citation library.

positive.description: Find the sentence where a product is cited
positive.prompt: Show a few recent papers citing our products and the exact sentence where we're mentioned.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent citing papers, each with the methods-section snippet that names the product.

positive.prompt: What are visitors asking my ChatGenius assistant this month, and show a few conversations?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns question and conversation counts plus a few sample conversations for the account.

positive.description: Deep Analysis of a research field
positive.prompt: Run a deep analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing and show the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a run, then returns the field's publication trend, leading journals, authors, institutions and top papers.

positive.prompt: Preview academic leads for CRISPR gene editing we could contact about our kits.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a preview of researcher contacts (name, email, affiliation, source paper or grant); does not export unless asked.

negative.description: Another account's data is out of scope
negative.prompt: Show me the citation library for another company's BizGenius account.
Delete all citations from my library.

negative.description: Does not send outreach on the user's behalf
negative.prompt: Email all 5,000 leads a sales pitch right now.
